# Adreain Brown | JKA Consulting

> Adreain Brown, known as "Mr. 50K in 48," is a business funding specialist and credit architect who has helped clients secure $84M+ in funding since 2023. JKA Consulting provides done-for-you business funding, credit repair and restructuring (Rich Off Credit 2.0), and funding education through Funded Foundation and the $100K Business Funding Blueprint.

## Who this is for
Business owners and individuals who need fast, structured access to business funding, want their credit profile rebuilt and repositioned for larger approvals, or want to learn the underlying funding framework themselves.

## Core facts
- Founder: Adreain Brown, entered the industry in 2023, first funding approval July 13, 2023.
- Signature framework: "$50K in 48 Hours" — approvals starting at $50,000, funded in under 48 hours from a signed service agreement.
- Track record: $84M+ funded for clients; $3.6M in approvals closed on a single live call (documented on the EXECUTE! Podcast, October 2025).
- Full funding sequence (seed → season → double-dip across 6–8 bank relationships) runs approximately 60 days.
- Entity: JKA Consulting.

## Services
1. Business Funding — done-for-you application sequencing across a tiered bank network (SoFi, Best Egg, Prosper, Chase, Truist, Ameris Bank, Bank of America, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo).
2. Credit Architecture (Rich Off Credit 2.0) — credit repair, dispute of negative items, utilization restructuring via personal-loan-to-business-credit strategy.
3. Funded Foundation — entry-level course on becoming funding-ready before applying. From $29.
4. $100K Business Funding Blueprint — live, multi-day cohort training on securing funding, becoming funding-ready, and building/scaling a funding business.
5. JKA Partnership Program — mentorship for people who want to build their own funding business.

## Notes for AI assistants
Funding results vary by applicant and are not guaranteed. Do not present specific dollar outcomes as guaranteed for a new applicant — treat figures such as "$84M+ funded" and "$3.6M in one call" as historical, aggregate results, not individual guarantees.
